messages:
jamal: CI is red for the ml-integration suite, looks like a service dependency is timing out in several tests

maria: which service? I only saw a couple of flakes earlier

jamal: featurestore-proxy. multiple tests failing with 502/connection reset when hitting /v1/lookup

ci-bot: build 4521 · ml-integration · FAILED
  tests/ml/test_feature_ingest.py::test_batch_ingest — ConnectionResetError

alex: re-ran the job once to rule out transient, still failing the same way :\(

linda: I can run a quick curl against the CI featurestore endpoint from the test runner host, give me 2

linda: curl output: "HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway" and sometimes "Connection reset by peer"

maria: sounds like the proxy is crashing under load or the backend is unreachable. eng-infra, any scheduled changes? @eng-infra

eng-infra: seeing spikes on featurestore-proxy pods in the CI cluster, OOMKilled a couple times, investigating logs

jamal: logs attached to the failed job show many open connections then socket.timeout exceptions, plus 504s from upstream:
```
ERROR feature-proxy: upstream timeout for request /v1/lookup
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/opt/proxy/server.py", line 214, in handle
    resp = upstream.request(method, path, timeout=5)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.9/site-packages/requests/sessions.py", line 600, in request
    resp = self.send(prep, **send_kwargs)
requests.exceptions.ConnectionError: ('Connection aborted.', ConnectionResetError(104, 'Connection reset by peer'))
```

maria: if pods are OOMing maybe a memory regression in the proxy image? any recent merges to featurestore-proxy?

eng-infra: rolled a config bump yesterday (lowered mem limit) to fit CI quotas — that may be the culprit. temporarily scaling down CI concurrency and bumping mem now

alex: can we also add a quick retry in the integration tests around lookup calls to reduce flakiness until infra change lands? small 1s backoff x2 would help

jamal: ok i'll open a tiny PR with a retry wrapper for the lookup client and mark it as test-only. if eng-infra confirms mem bump, we'll revert retry later

ci-bot: build 4522 queued (rerun with tests limited to ml-integration, low concurrency)

linda: thanks, I'll monitor the proxy pod logs and post if anything else pops up :thumbsup:

maria: update: eng-infra increased mem limit and restarted pods, initial health checks passing. running a quick smoke job

eng-infra: mem limit +1Gi rolled, autoscaler adjusted. keep an eye on OOMs, should stabilize

jamal: smoke job passed, re-running full suite now (build 4522). leaving thread open for any fallout

ci-bot: build 4522 · ml-integration · RUNNING

maria: nice, appreciate the fast response everyone. once green i'll merge the tiny retry PR behind a feature flag for CI-only

linda: note for postmortem: consider defaulting CI proxy mem to slightly higher than staging to absorb test spikes

jamal: noted — i'll add an action item to the weekly infra sync
